action.objective: Develop the c1-bishop to f4, answering ...Bb4 and keeping the center solid.
action.rationale: c1f4 is the only commit_ready move. Broad depth-3 search over all 27 legal roots ranked it top (exact 29), and single-candidate verification at effective depth 4 found no forced mate, no tactical refutation (not_found), and passed the complete immediate-mate check scope. The bishop leaves c1 before Black's ...Bxc3+ can come with tempo, develops a minor, and the PV Bf4 Qf6 e3 keeps material level with active pieces. Alternatives a2a4/g2g4/h2h4 (28) are shallower upper-bound estimates only, not stronger evidence. Note: after Bf4, Black has ...Nxd4 and ...Bxc3+ available; the verification confirms no immediate mate, though quiet threats and longer lines remain uncertain at this bounded depth.
